patch.value: Overlap refreshed: published core previewItemMutations owns canonical transaction semantics; CSV owns CSV schemas and mapping; Beads owns its external format. Native preflight supplies agents without Node or Git and introduces no importer dialect. Reuse native apply functions in disposable bounded snapshots; source bytes remain unchanged. No lock-based isolation or live commit guarantee is claimed.
Preview canonical item admission without native tracker writes
Bounded Rust SDK and CLI preflight for canonical item intents using the native mutation path.

Unsupported intent kinds refuse before any write; admitted and refused fixtures match the published TypeScript previewItemMutations oracle for the declared slice; every byte and row limit is reported.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation uses shared native create/update document preparation and the existing native status registry. Preview has no persistence phase: ordered candidate state stays in memory, independent row failures retain diagnostics, and a refused target suppresses later same-target intents. Hard input/source/row/directory/depth/output ceilings are reported. The declared slice is progressive explicit-scope creates and scalar updates; custom field/type workflows and complex lifecycle transitions refuse explicitly. Published oracle remains repo-pinned at 2026.10.21 per package policy; current registry pm is 2026.10.28. Unsupported operation kinds refuse before tracker discovery. No transaction-lock isolation or future commit guarantee is claimed.
